data.gender_notes: Afreen is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian āfrīn, 'praise, blessing, bravo'. Its root is Persian āfrīn. A Persian and Urdu given name. Afreen is a Persian name meaning “Praise; encouragement; bravo”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Afreen expresses “Praise; encouragement; bravo”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Persian āfrīn, 'praise, blessing, bravo'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afreen total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
